strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with interleaved scaling
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with scale/descale operations interleaved between them, matching the reference implementation structure. Total 8 all-reduce dispatches plus local element-wise operations (scale by a[r]/W, then descale by a[r]). Represents the baseline: maximal correctness clarity, no fusion, highest dispatch count.

strategies.name: Fused buffer preparation before all-reduces
strategies.desc: Fuses all local scaling operations (buf[r*S:(r+1)*S] = a[r] * s[r*S:(r+1)*S] / W) into single vectorized operations before each all-reduce, eliminating per-shard loops. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces local compute overhead and improves memory access patterns. Tradeoff: same communication cost, lower local compute latency.

strategies.name: Pre-compute scaling coefficients with broadcasting
strategies.desc: Pre-materializes the scaling vector (a[r]/W repeated S times for each rank's shard) once, then uses element-wise multiply instead of loops. The 8 all-reduces remain but local ops become single broadcasts and element-wise multiplies. Reduces dispatch count for local ops from O(W) per iteration to O(1), improving kernel launch overhead.

strategies.name: Pipelined all-reduce with double-buffering
strategies.desc: Overlaps computation of buffer preparation for iteration i+1 while all-reduce i is in flight using separate buffer allocations. Requires 2x memory but can hide local compute latency behind communication. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces critical path by overlapping independent operations.

strategies.name: Hierarchical reduction with intra-node optimization
strategies.desc:
Exploits potential multi-node topology by performing node-local reductions first (if num_nodes > 1), then inter-node all-reduce, repeating for 8 iterations. For world_size=224, could use node-aware collectives to reduce cross-node bandwidth pressure. Dispatch count remains 8 all-reduces but changes collective topology/algorithm selection for better network utilization.
